provenance.sourceMethod: inspected-official-source means measured bytes from exact official source URL, not independent publisher digest.
limitations: File ownership metadata is not a PE import graph; the producer checks actual imports.
Snapshot databases and the separately dated bootstrap are not an atomic repository transaction.
Expected inventory is checked against the actual installed environment before source execution.
